label: Week 32, 2026
recap:
This was a quiet week for AI policy activity, with 4 bill movements and 5 case updates recorded, and no federal agency documents. Activity was concentrated at the federal level, with the United States Congress accounting for 3 jurisdiction counts and California accounting for 1. Where themes were identifiable, transparency and disclosure appeared twice, touching on labeling AI-generated output and impact assessments, while health care and infrastructure and energy each appeared once, the latter tied to data centers and their power draw. Two bills did not fall under a specific tracked theme.

Overall, the week reflected modest, incremental movement rather than major developments. Bill movements indicate that the status of these records changed, not that any bill passed or was defeated. With five case updates logged, litigation activity was slightly more active than legislative activity, though still limited in scope. No new federal documents were noted, and the jurisdictional spread remained narrow, centered mainly on congressional action with a single California entry rounding out the week.
